description: The openCircuitPotential and entropyChange functions use the fits in Table II of: Torchio, M., Magni, L., Gopaluni, R. B., Braatz, R. D., and Raimondo, D. M. (2016). LIONSIMBA: A Matlab Framework Based on a Finite Volume Model Suitable for Li-Ion Battery Design, Simulation, and Control. Journal of The Electrochemical Society, 163(7), A1192-A1205. DOI: 10.1149/2.0291607jes. A source for every other scalar parameter in this file has not been established.
